facts.text: Shift's over, Fortune, and there's enough food here for the whole team. Pull up a chair for the second half.
facts.why: Fortune is the groundskeeper at Notre Dame Stadium, not at the Joliet mill. The note speaks to him in the wrong place, and Rudy never hosts the team at the mill.
facts.fix: Shift's over. Eat up, because I'm heading to South Bend and I'm not coming back till I've played.
